displayName: Allow co-authors to chat within a document (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether co-authors can use the chat functionality within an Office application to collaborate with each other when editing a document.

If you enable or don’t configure this policy setting, users can chat with each other when co-authoring a document.

If you disable this policy setting, users can’t chat with each other when co-authoring a document.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus.
